checks.name: Unknown performance and dimensions survive parsing
Original data is copied without extra injected fields
Dimensions reject negatives, fractions, strings and unsafe limits
Unknown cannot silently become numeric zero
Documented input requires a bounded safe link, not a certification claim
Duplicate IDs and invalid geometry fail explicitly
Bounded lists and original-study mode are enforced
Default selection and exact URL round trip
Repeated or unsupported route choices fall back with warnings
Unrelated fragments retain the active information panel
All symbolic plans stay finite and carry the selected panel count
Brief is plain text with selected values and preserved unknowns
Brief rejects oversized fields and unsupported selections

limitations: Original fictional data and deterministic fixtures only
Document references are input provenance, not independently verified engineering evidence
